steps.name: show-furniture
steps.eval: (async () => { const nap = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const root = document.querySelector('.plan-screen'); const findFurn = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-pressed]')].find(b => (b.textContent||'').trim() === 'Furniture'); for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { let f = findFurn(); if (!f) { const open = [...root.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup="menu"]')].find(b => /^\s*View/.test(b.textContent||'')); open?.click(); await nap(200); f = findFurn(); } if (f && f.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true') { f.click(); await nap(200); } if (document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen polygon[data-item-id]').length >= 3) return 'shown'; await nap(150); } return { state: 'failed', footprints: document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen polygon[data-item-id]').length }; })()

steps.name: marquee-compute
steps.eval: (() => { const svg = document.querySelector('svg.plan-paper'); const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); const polys = [...svg.querySelectorAll('polygon[data-item-id]')]; const cents = polys.map(p => { const pts = p.getAttribute('points').trim().split(/\s+/).map(s => s.split(',').map(Number)); const cx = pts.reduce((a,[x])=>a+x,0)/pts.length; const cy = pts.reduce((a,[,y])=>a+y,0)/pts.length; const sx = r.left + cx * r.width / svg.width.baseVal.value; const sy = r.top + cy * r.height / svg.height.baseVal.value; return { id:p.getAttribute('data-item-id'), cx, cy, sx, sy }; }); cents.sort((a,b)=>a.cx-b.cx); const a = cents[0], b = cents[1], c = cents[2]; window.__mq = { x0: (a.sx*3 - b.sx)/2, x1: (b.sx + c.sx)/2, top: Math.min(a.sy,b.sy) - 22, bot: Math.max(a.sy,b.sy) + 22 }; window.__fire = (type, x, y, btns) => svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles:true, cancelable:true, clientX:x, clientY:y, button:0, buttons: btns, pointerId:1, pointerType:'mouse' })); })()
